raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-16 payments-source change renamed the card-feed status POSTED to SETTLED with unchanged meaning, but silver_transactions still filters on status = 'POSTED'. Batches 12-14 arrive as SETTLED and are dropped, which is why they reach silver with 0 rows. Filtering on both values restores the intended set of posted transactions and leaves REVERSED excluded.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED');"}}
